IGDX Bootcamp is a 5-month program designed for talented game developers
by providing technical skills and hands-on experience in game development.
Throughout the program, participants work on a real project from the ground
up, starting from ideation to final pitching.
During this bootcamp, I took on a dual role as both a Game Programmer and
Game Business strategist. On the technical side, I ensured the game was
properly implemented and delivered as expected, while on the business side
I was responsible for developing marketing strategies, creating a compelling
pitch deck, and pitching to stakeholders.
This experience also helped me sharpen essential soft skills such as
communication, time management, public speaking, and problem-solving,

allowing me to grow both as a developer and as a future game industry
professional.
